description: This file defines the routing configuration for a Flutter mobile application. It implements a custom Router using Flutter's Navigator 2.0 API, with a simple route parser, a router delegate, and route mappings to various screens such as onboarding and profile.

classes.name: _SimpleRouteParser
classes.description: Parses route information into a string representation and restores route information from a string.

classes.name: _SimpleRouterDelegate
classes.description: Manages the navigation stack based on route path, builds the navigator widget, and responds to route changes.

methods.name: buildRouter
methods.description: Constructs and returns a RouterConfig object configured with route information provider, parser, and delegate.
